verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a scriptable Editor API for programmatic scene manipulation, asset management and custom tooling. It also ships an official MCP server that modifies project data in an open Editor session, and the same components are available whether you build in the Editor, the engine, React or Web Components. The plans page lists REST API access but gives no scope, there is no OpenAPI spec, and nothing claims the API matches everything the UI can do. The Editor API and MCP server also depend on an open browser Editor session rather than working headlessly. Missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity statement, documented REST API scope or OpenAPI spec, headless programmatic access independent of an open Editor session, independent corroboration of API completeness.
